title.narrative: Promoting the adaptation and adoption of RECP (resource efficient and cleaner production) in Serbia through the Cleaner Production Centre (CPC) - Phase II

description.narrative: Phase II of the UNIDO project for the NCPC in Serbia aims at further enhancing the resource productivity, competitiveness and environmental performance of industry in Serbia. It will support the adaptation and adoption of resource efficient and cleaner production (RECP) methods, practices, technologies and policies, providing national industries with the necessary tools to facilitate access to national and regional markets with environmentally sound products and improve the ability of national enterprises to successfully negotiate their position in the global market. The present project builds on the results and lessons learned during the implementation of the UNIDO Phase I for establishing a National Cleaner Production Centre in Serbia which has been ongoing since 2007 and the good cooperation with the national host institution, the Faculty of Technology and Metallurgy of the University of Belgrade. After Phase I of project implementation, the market for RECP is not yet fully developed and the Centre has not reached its full self -sustainability. Additional efforts for RECP promotion and capacity building as well as up-scaling of RECP application at company are required.
